jobs.title: Associate Creative Director - Art
jobs.description:
Agency

Area23

Job Function

Creative

Job Subfunction

Art Direction

Job Description

About the Job:

As an Associate Creative Director - Art, you'll lead innovative creative campaigns across multiple accounts and brands, fostering inspiration and overseeing art direction, visual translation, and execution. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will ensure creative integrity, strategic alignment, and exceptional craft. You'll supervise and develop art team members, drive client relationships, and contribute to new business growth. By combining artistic vision with strategic thinking, you'll deliver compelling, award-worthy solutions.

A Day In The Life

Lead creative ideation, partnering with accounts, senior management, and clients to develop brand personality, positioning, and briefs.
Drive executional craft, collaborating with production to deliver high-quality work on time and budget.
Foster cross-functional collaboration, communicating effectively across departments.
Manage client relationships, understanding brand vision and messaging.
Develop and advocate for marketing strategies, possessing in-depth brand knowledge.
Supervise and mentor team members.
Ensure team utilization and productivity, partnering with Creative Resourcing.
Contribute to new business growth through pitch concepting and execution.
Demonstrate leadership, empathy, and professionalism in communications.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Design or related field.
7+ years of experience in Visual Communications, Graphic Design or Art Direction.
Pharmaceutical/Healthcare advertising experience (preferred).
Digital portfolio showcasing creative ability.
Expertise in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
Ability to inspire team confidence and motivation towards common goals.
Ability to foster collaborative environment, creativity and bold ideas.
Excellent interpersonal skills, coaching and people management.
Strategic thinking, problem-solving and communication skills.
Financial management and resourcing acumen.

$150,000- $170,000

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Executive Creative Director, Creative Development - Temporary Worker
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Freelance Executive Creative Director
is a senior creative leader brought in to help shape high-impact, business-driving work for a major enterprise retail client. This role requires someone who can quickly earn trust, establish creative standards, and lead integrated teams through the realities of complex retail environments, from brand-building platforms to seasonal campaigns, commerce, shopper, digital, social, in-store, content, CRM, and production deliverables.

The Role…

As a Freelance Executive Creative Director, you will partner closely with agency creative leadership, strategy, account, production, media, and client teams to bring clarity, momentum, and creative ambition to a fast-moving enterprise retail account. You will be expected to plug in quickly, understand the client’s brand, category, customer journey, promotional rhythms, stakeholder landscape, and operational complexity, then translate that understanding into work that is distinctive, effective, and executable.

You are a seasoned creative leader with deep enterprise retail experience and a portfolio that shows both brand-level thinking and commercially grounded execution. You know how to lead creative work that has to perform across national campaigns, retail media, owned channels, loyalty ecosystems, product/category moments, merchandising, and store-level or shelf-connected touchpoints.

This is a freelance engagement for a leader who can operate with senior-level independence, guide teams in real time, shape presentations, strengthen the work before it reaches clients, and help the agency deliver with confidence in a high-volume, high-visibility retail environment.

We are seeking talent in the New York or Boston area only.

This role has a host of expectations, including, but not limited to the following:

Creative Excellence. You...

Drive creative excellence across integrated retail work, ensuring ideas are strategically sharp, beautifully crafted, channel-right, and grounded in how retail customers actually discover, evaluate, buy, and engage with brands.
Bring a strong understanding of enterprise retail ecosystems, including brand campaigns, promotional moments, loyalty, CRM, retail media, digital commerce, social, content, in-store, packaging-adjacent, and shopper touchpoints.
Translate business objectives, customer insights, category dynamics, and merchandising priorities into creative ideas that can move both brand perception and commercial outcomes.
Guide teams from brief through concept, presentation, refinement, production, and delivery while protecting the creative standard and helping the work stay executable within timing, budget, and operational realities.

Enterprise Retail Leadership. You...

Have led creative for large, complex retail, commerce, consumer goods, pharmacy/health, mass, grocery, home, beauty, apparel, technology, or equivalent enterprise clients.
Understand the pace, volume, stakeholder complexity, review cycles, regulatory or compliance considerations, and operational discipline required to support enterprise-scale retail work.
Can elevate work that needs to serve multiple jobs at once: building the brand, driving traffic, supporting category and product priorities, converting customers, and staying consistent across a wide ecosystem of touchpoints.
Know how to balance breakthrough thinking with practical retail realities, including promotional calendars, claims, legal review, partner approvals, modular toolkits, asset variation, and production efficiency.

C
ollaboration + Client Partnership. You...

Build trust quickly with internal teams and senior client stakeholders, bringing calm, clarity, and creative authority to fast-moving discussions.
Partner closely with account, strategy, media, production, project management, and client teams to pressure-test ideas, strengthen the work, and make sure deliverables ladder back to the strategy.
Present creative work with confidence, business rationale, and a clear point of view, helping clients understand not only what the idea is, but why it will matter.
Operate as a flexible senior partner who can lead the room, coach the team, sharpen a deck, solve a creative challenge, or step into client-facing conversations as needed.

Leading the Work + Team. You...

Guide art directors, copywriters, designers, social/content creatives, production partners, and extended teams with clear direction, useful feedback, and high standards.
Create momentum without creating friction, helping teams move quickly while staying aligned on priorities, expectations, and creative ambition.
Know when to push, when to simplify, and when to help teams make smart tradeoffs so the work gets better and gets out the door.
Model an inclusive, collaborative, ego-free leadership style that helps permanent and freelance team members do their best work.

Operationally, you...

Can onboard quickly, ask the right questions, identify gaps, and establish a productive working rhythm with the agency and client team.
Help shape creative reviews, internal checkpoints, client presentations, and production handoffs so the work advances with focus and quality.
Manage multiple workstreams and timelines with strong judgment, escalating risks early and helping teams stay focused on the highest-value creative decisions.
Bring freelance agility while operating with the ownership, discretion, and leadership presence expected of an executive creative partner.

Qualifications:

15+ years of creative experience, including senior creative leadership within an agency, retail, commerce, shopper, brand, or integrated marketing environment.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise retail or similarly complex, high-volume client work with multiple stakeholders, channels, and approval layers.
Strong portfolio showing integrated creative leadership across brand, digital, social, content, retail media, shopper, CRM, experiential, OOH, film/video, and/or in-store touchpoints.
Proven ability to lead teams, present to senior clients, shape creative strategy, and deliver work that is both distinctive and commercially effective.
Comfort operating in a freelance capacity, including fast onboarding, flexible collaboration, strong communication, clear prioritization, and reliable delivery against tight timelines.
Bachelor’s degree, portfolio school background, or equivalent professional experience in advertising, design, marketing, communications, or a related field.

The annual salary range for this position is $197,225-$263,062. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Temporary employees are eligible for paid holidays in accordance with dentsu policy, as well as safe and sick time. This position is not eligible for any other benefits or other compensation. This assignment is expected to run through December 2026.

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be accepted until September 16, 2026.

jobs.title: AI Creative Producer
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

AI-generated content is becoming a dominant format across social, creator, and product marketing. Models are evolving at high speed, new modalities unlock new creative possibilities, and audiences now expect a level of quality that traditional production can’t keep up with.

We’re currently producing content that reaches millions of people every month, but we’re in a fast-growing market, and we’ve only begun to show what ElevenLabs’ creative tools can do.

We’re hiring an AI Creative Producer to join our Creator Growth team to help scale our content production.

You’ll help define what great AI-generated content looks like — from cinematic visuals and short films to social assets that inspire millions of creators. Your mission is to prototype workflows, test models, and push the creative boundaries of ElevenLabs’ AI tools.

You’ll work closely with our social and growth teams to produce content that drives awareness, teaches creators what’s possible, and showcases the future of AI-powered storytelling.

Requirements

We’re looking for a uniquely creative and technically fluent individual who thrives at the intersection of storytelling and generative media.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Have deep experience prompting for image, video, and audio models — with a strong portfolio of examples.
Have a sharp design eye and can distinguish between good and great creative.
Understand how to craft stories and communicate visually.
Know how discovery works across YouTube, Instagram, and X.
Move fast and independently, with strong creative instincts.
Have experience collaborating with visual or social media teams.
Experience editing in Premiere Pro or similar tools.

What you’ll do

Create world-class AI-generated visuals and videos using ElevenLabs.
Create large numbers of examples for our explore page
Write, refine, and document prompts for cinematic, realistic, and stylized outputs.
Build prompt guides and workflows to help others replicate and learn from your results.
Collaborate with the social team to educate users and inspire the community.
Develop repeatable AI content workflows and help package them for public use.
Produce growth-driven, social-first assets such as teasers, comparisons, and educational clips.
Stress-test ElevenLabs tools and contribute structured feedback to the product team.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed from anywhere in Europe. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
